name: marketplace-module-monorepo
description: Complete Marketplace Module Monorepo (Client Web, Mobile App, Admin Panel, Express/MongoDB Backend)

scripts.start:backend: node init && cd backend && npm start
scripts.start:admin: node init && cd admin-panel && npm run dev
scripts.start:client: node init && cd client-web && npm run dev
scripts.start:mobile: node init && cd mobile-app && flutter run -d chrome
